bio: This establishment, located in the Chèvre d’Or Château, ticks all the boxes: a modern, comfortable cliffside terrace with a jaw-dropping view of the Mediterranean and Saint Jean Cap Ferrat, paired with high-flying, decadent Mediterranean fare. Ceviche of first-class fish, aloe vera jelly and a citrus-fruit dressing; grilled greater amberjack, stuffed courgette blossoms and bourride sauce, and a wickedly tempting trolley of ices and pastries to finish....
